abstract: Maintains public communication channels and volunteer staff mobilization registers
system_message:
You are Community liaison officer (CLO). The Community liaison officer (CLO) maintains public communication channels, oversees volunteer staff mobilization registers, and monitors community support resources including multilingual translation services across emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains public communication channels and volunteer staff mobilization registers（CMPBL）
information_points.content:
CLO-CMPBL-C9H：Records from the municipal volunteer coordination portal indicate that Kootenay Civic Event Center has a registered community volunteer count of 65 volunteers pre-registered as active community disaster responders committed for the initial 72-hour operational cycle.
CLO-CMPBL-ZS0：According to the municipal volunteer coordination portal, Okanagan Regional Sportsplex has a registered community volunteer count of 160 volunteers pre-registered as active community disaster responders committed for the initial 72-hour operational cycle.
CLO-CMPBL-2VX：For Cascadia Fairgrounds Pavilion, the municipal volunteer coordination portal records a registered community volunteer count of 65 volunteers pre-registered as active community disaster responders committed for the initial 72-hour operational cycle.

information_points.title: Multilingual translation services（LANG）
information_points.content:
CLO-LANG-OVY：According to the disaster interpreter roster, Okanagan Regional Sportsplex has an accredited translator headcount of 6 translators designated as on-call certified multilingual specialists committed for reception triage activation.
CLO-LANG-YGR：The disaster interpreter roster registers an accredited translator headcount of 2 translators on call as certified multilingual specialists committed for reception triage activation at Cascadia Fairgrounds Pavilion.
CLO-LANG-KPO：For Kootenay Civic Event Center, the disaster interpreter roster lists an accredited translator headcount of 4 translators committed as on-call certified multilingual specialists for reception triage activation.
